posts.what: Lumi turns a pocket watch's crown, the island's creatures moonwalk back along their last nine seconds to where they started with a tape-style overlay, then time runs forward again and they choose something new.
posts.recipe: Lumi finds a gadget, uses it on the whole island, everyone is affected for a few seconds, then it undoes itself and the day goes on
posts.shared: Lumi's found item triggers an island-wide effect on all friends that is then undone; the effect itself (time reversal of motion, no new body or prop) works differently and has no backfire or big payoff
